1_tx_ps_to_encoder.meaning: TX PS takes the frame -> first image byte into the encoder (PS)

2_encoder_input.meaning: image bytes flowing into the encoder (DMA, paced by the encoder)

3a_encoder_first_out.meaning: first byte in -> first symbol out (encoder pipeline)

3b_encoder_tail.meaning: last byte in -> last symbol out (encoder pipeline)

4_tx_buffer_to_air.meaning: last symbol -> frame finished on the air (OFDM + frame buffer + 2.75 ms air)

5_air_start_to_rx_sync.meaning: frame starts on the air -> first RX PHY data symbol (preamble, sync, CE)

7_decoding.meaning: first RX PHY symbol -> last decoded byte

7b_decoding_after_last_symbol.meaning: last RX PHY symbol -> last decoded byte

8_rx_pl_to_dma.meaning: last decoded byte -> forwarded to the PS DMA path

9_rx_ps_receive.meaning: image forwarded -> PS has it (DMA + rx_server, first UDP chunk)

PL_encoder_in_to_decoder_out.meaning: first image byte into the encoder -> last decoded byte (TX clock -> RX clock)

TX_PS_take_to_air_start.meaning: TX PS takes the frame -> frame starts on the air

END_TO_END_ps_to_ps.meaning: TX PS takes the frame -> RX PS has the decoded image
